content.text: The fcrepo4-client doesn't support creation of fedora 4 resources where the ID isn't explicitly specified.  The fcrepo-camel client code doesn't allow the custom headers needed to create versions or new objects with a given ID, so this ticket will likely require modifying one of those projects.
It looks like the fcrepo-camel code supports a PUT request. Can you not use that to create the resource at the specified location?
Yeah... that would work... I forgot there were two ways to create a named resource.  (POST with a slug vs PUT)
, can you please rebase this PR on the master branch. I am getting merge conflicts.
The current id mapping strategy runs up against costly-to-fix shortcomings in the fedora 4 architecture.
Create a simpler mapping that just:
1.  assigns each f3 pid a new path in Fedora 4 using the default PIDs minted by fedora 4
2.  persists that mapping somewhere for use when that pid is later referenced
